jobs.description:
Your role

As a Customer Service Agent, you will be the main point of contact for customers, workshops and other parties involved. Your goal is to provide excellent customer service while ensuring that every case is followed up accurately and efficiently.

Your main responsibilities will include:

 
• 
Handling incoming phone calls and customer inquiries.

 
• 
Managing emails and providing clear and professional responses.

 
• 
Gathering information and checking data for accuracy and completeness.

 
• 
Providing first-line technical support and communicating with workshops.

 
• 
Keeping customers and all relevant parties informed about the progress of their case.

 
• 
Following up and monitoring agreements with all parties involved.

 
• 
Managing contract-related issues within the agreed deadlines.

 
• 
Managing several cases and tasks simultaneously while maintaining a high level of service.

Working hours

The position is Monday to Friday, with occasional Saturday work during particularly busy periods.

You will work in rotating shifts between 07:00 and 22:00.

Flexibility regarding working hours is essential for this position.

Your profile

We are looking for someone who is customer-focused, communicative and able to multitask in a fast-paced environment.

Knowledge & experience

 
• 
Very good English – essential for the position and the main working language.

 
• 
Good knowledge of French.

 
• 
Good knowledge of Dutch.

 
• 
Good knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.).

 
• 
Previous experience in administration, customer service or case management is a strong asset.

 
• 
Technical knowledge of the automotive sector, tyres or mechanics is a plus, but not required.

 
• 
No specific experience is required, as full training will be provided.

Skills & personality

 
• 
Excellent telephone communication skills.

 
• 
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

 
• 
Naturally customer-oriented and service-minded.

 
• 
Able to multitask and manage several cases at the same time.

 
• 
Accurate, organised and committed to delivering high-quality work.

 
• 
Stress-resistant and able to remain calm in challenging situations.

 
• 
Flexible and quick to adapt to new tools, procedures and situations.

 
• 
Reliable, motivated and eager to learn.

• Confident with digital tools, websites, and social media.
• Skilled in Microsoft Office and collaborative platforms.
• Highly organised with strong prioritisation abilities.
• Comfortable interacting with diverse stakeholders.
• Proactive, solution-oriented, and able to work independently.
• Calm and reliable under time pressure.

jobs.occupation: Commercial Coordinator for the Beer Sector
jobs.description:

• You have your own transportation

• You are able to work in a two-shift system (5am-1pm and 1pm-9pm)
 
• You are willing to complete in-house training
 
• You have a truly hands-on attitude
 
• You are a team player

jobs.occupation: g2 Recruitment Solutions - Guidewire Implementation Product Owner + Business Analyst
jobs.description:
For a major insurance transformation program (Brussels Region), we are looking for an experienced freelance Product Owner with Guidewire experience to join a greenfield Guidewire Cloud implementation within Commercial Insurance.

The Product Owner will take ownership of PolicyCenter and Product Definition, working closely with business stakeholders, Business Analysts, configuration developers and other members of a distributed Agile delivery team.
Key responsibilities

• Take Product Ownership for Guidewire PolicyCenter / Product Definition

• Define and prioritise business and functional requirements

• Build, maintain and prioritise the product backlog

• Translate requirements into clear user stories together with the Business Analysts

• Drive scope and priorities throughout the different delivery phases

• Contribute to solution design and ensure alignment between business and technical teams

• Provide direction and partial leadership to the Scrum team

• Work closely with 3 - 4 Business Analysts and Guidewire configuration developers

• Coordinate with stakeholders and project team members across multiple locations

• Support the upcoming inception phase and subsequent build and delivery activities

Project context

• Greenfield Guidewire Cloud implementation

• Focus on Commercial Insurance

• PolicyCenter and Product Definition at the core of the role

• Scrum team of approximately 10 people, including 3-4 Business Analysts and configuration developers

• International/distributed project environment

• First release currently moving into User Acceptance Testing

• Next release starts with an inception phase covering requirements, solution design and user-story backlog creation

• Earlier onboarding preferred to build project and policy knowledge ahead of the next major delivery phase

Terms:

• Freelance / Long-term

• Hybrid - Europe

• Occasional on-site travel

• Start: Before the end of 2026

• English-speaking

• Strong experience as a Product Owner within complex IT transformation programs

• Previous Guidewire experience, with PolicyCenter being particularly relevant

• Good understanding of insurance policy and product processes

• Strong experience with backlog management, requirements, prioritisation and user stories

• Insurance experience; Non-Life/ P&C experience is highly relevant

• Commercial Insurance experience is an advantage but not a strict requirement

• Strong Agile/Scrum experience

• Able to bridge business, functional and technical stakeholders

• Comfortable providing direction to a multidisciplinary and distributed Scrum team

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

• Professional working English

What will you have to do?
 

 
• Learn how to prepare our extensive range of chocolates
 
• You’ll learn the recipes so you can perform all tasks independently
 
• You’ll keep your workstation tidy, because that’s how you prefer to work
 
• As a line operator, you’ll set up the machine according to the correct parameters and adjust them as needed.
 
• You inspect the quality of the finished products.
 
• You supply the raw materials and packaging materials to the production line.
 
• Converting machines is also part of your responsibilities, as is cleaning and maintaining the production line. 

Who are you?
 

 
• You have a degree as a chocolatier, baker, or pastry chef OR possess the necessary experience
 
• Recent graduates in the fields of chocolatier, baker, or pastry chef are also welcome
 
• You are able to work in a two-shift system (5:00 AM–1:00 PM / 1:00 PM–9:00 PM)
 
• You adhere to hygiene and safety standards
 
• You have your own transportation
 
• You have a good to very good knowledge of Dutch or English
 
• You are willing to undergo in-house training
 
• You have a truly hands-on attitude
 
• You are a team player

jobs.occupation: Become a Forklift Operator at a Sustainable Recycling Company
jobs.description:
As a forklift operator, you’ll join an innovative plastic recycling company where sustainability and circular economy are at the heart of what we do. In this role, you’ll be responsible for moving plastic waste around the site, loading and unloading trucks, and performing minor technical maintenance. Your work directly contributes to recycling plastic and building a greener future.

On a typical workday, you’ll work in one of two shifts: early shift from 5 AM to 2 PM, or late shift from 2 PM to 11 PM (sometimes 3 PM to 12 AM), always with a one-hour break. You’ll use a wheel loader and forklift to efficiently process plastic waste. Flexibility is important, as the shift schedule can vary slightly. Please note, the nature of recycling means the work environment can be less clean and sometimes involve odors. You’ll handle small technical issues yourself, while a maintenance technician is available for larger problems.

Are you ready to put your technical skills to good use and make a positive impact on the environment? Apply now and make a difference as an operator in the recycling industry!

• You have a valid forklift license

• You speak good English; knowledge of Dutch is an asset

• You have technical knowledge and can handle minor repairs or maintenance

• You’re flexible for early and late shift work

• Experience in a similar role is a plus, but not required

• You work accurately and value safety

As a Technical Support Advisor, you are the point of contact for BEA's business customers throughout Europe, with a particular history in the German-speaking area. 

Your missions:
 
Customer & internal technical support
  
• Answer customers' technical questions by phone, WhatsApp or e-mail, with a particular focus on VIP customers and high-value sensors. 
• Diagnose faults remotely and propose concrete solutions 
• Support our customers' technicians in the installation, wiring and configuration of BEA sensors. 
• Manage incoming calls from the technical hotline for Europe and provide product support to the European sales team. 
• Provide ongoing internal support in conjunction with other members of the technical team. 
• Participate in the creation, optimization and coordination of technical documentation (e.g. wiring diagrams, instructions) for customers in the field.  
Continuous improvement & documentation
  
• Collect and transmit relevant field feedback to the sales, product and R&D teams, in a logic of continuous improvement. 
• Write reports and feed the internal knowledge base, to promote the sharing of expertise within the company (sales, marketing, product). 
• Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) related to the quality of service and products, using a ticketing system, to measure customer satisfaction and identify areas for improvement. 
• Participate in product tests (BEA sensors and competitors) in collaboration with Product Management and R&D teams. 
• Organize the planning of customer visits by the technical team.  
Team
 
You will join the sales department, within the Pedestrian Door Detectors (PES) segment.
 
Your direct technical referent, Sandra, currently holds this position, which she knows like the back of her hand. She will still be active in customer technical support, with a stronger focus on internal training, while actively supporting you during your integration. Trilingual, rigorous, challenging and always available, she ensures that customers receive impeccable service.

Your experience and education: 
 
• Minimum 2 years of experience in a support function 
• Strong interest in electronic, electromechanical or connected solutions 
• Good command of office tools and ability to read technical guides 
• Excellent command of German, French and English (spoken and written)  
Your soft skills and personal qualities:
  
• Excellent interpersonal skills, ability to ask the right questions and reassure customers 
• Curiosity, thirst for learning and spirit of investigation 
• Method, rigor and stress management 
• Taste for teamwork and openness to feedback 
• Ability to interact with different internal contact (PM, sales, R&D, quality)

About K-Boringen:With its trenchless installation of pipelines and tunnels, K-Boringen has built a groundbreaking international reputation. Equipped with an extensive fleet of machinery and supported by more than 55 expert employees, K-Boringen guarantees an extremely smooth and flexible service, even in the most challenging work situations. To ensure continued growth, we are currently looking for new colleagues.Being naturally multilingual and equipped with an impressive machine park, the people at K-Boringen ensure an exceptionally smooth and flexible collaboration, even in the most demanding work conditions.Using tunnel boring machines, our professionals drill (micro)tunnels with diameters of up to 4 meters over lengths of, for example, 1 km. More information can be found at https://www.k-boringen.com/.To carry out our drilling projects across Europe, we are looking for motivated, competent employees who have a sense of responsibility and adventure.
